node.title: DLI engineered weight-6 witness reaches order 512 but not the production ambient split
node.statement: For z of order 512, the exact norm of 1-z^33+z^40-z^136-z^143+z^145 is 122312418397310579415219240127455896396372121843316076135243835573788121252866 = 2q, where q=61156209198655289707609620063727948198186060921658038067621917786894060626433 is prime and v_2(q-1)=9. Thus the banked engineered weight-6 construction gives a terminal order-512 relation but none of its norm factors can host the production ambient subgroup of order 2^41. FLINT recomputes the resultant on Modal; PARI factors it; a local recursive Pocklington verifier proves the 256-bit factor prime and checks an exact order-512 vanishing dilation.
